title: Rebuild hydration tick schedules when live configuration changes
description:
## Finding

Live reload updates configuration but existing tickers for clock, CI, PR, usage, weather, calendar, and LOC keep their startup cadence/enabled state. The UI shows new settings that do not govern runtime behavior.

## Evidence at audited commit

`crates/thegn-host/src/run.rs:1023` and `crates/thegn-host/src/hydrate.rs:527`.

## Implementation constraints

Own schedulers behind a versioned config update path with cancellation. Avoid duplicate tickers and immediate thundering refreshes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Enable/disable and interval changes take effect without restarting the app.
- [ ] Old ticker tasks are canceled and cannot deliver stale-generation results.
- [ ] Unchanged schedules are not restarted unnecessarily.
- [ ] Invalid reload retains the last effective schedule and reports the mismatch.
- [ ] Fake-time tests cover all ticker classes, rapid reloads, disable during inflight work, and shutdown.

## Verification

Run hydration scheduling/live-reload tests with fake time; run `just quick`.

## Execution dependencies

* **Blocked by:** None; dependency-ready at audit baseline.
